summary.name: AVCLabs AI
summary.one_liner: AVCLabs AI is a suite of AI tools for enhancing, restoring, editing and anonymizing photos and videos, available on desktop and online.
use_cases: restore scratched or stained old photos
upscale old home movies to HD
blur faces or hide sensitive info in video
remove watermarks, text or people from footage
summary.what_it_does: The page describes AI features for restoring old photos by removing scratches, stains and noise while restoring clarity and color. It can convert old or low-resolution home videos to HD quality. It enhances product texture and detail for e-commerce displays. It also offers privacy protection by obscuring sensitive information in video, and removing watermarks, text, people or backgrounds from photos and videos. The page says object removal is available both locally and online.
notable: Restores old photos by removing scratches, stains and noise
Upscales old or low-resolution home videos to HD
Object removal works both locally (desktop) and online
caveats: Pricing not stated on the page; the directory listing describes the background remover as free
Specific supported desktop operating systems are not named on the page
